text_blocks.snippet: The contagious stage of COVID-19 typically lasts for about 5-10 days. During this period, an infected person can transmit the virus to others through close contact, respiratory droplets, or contaminated surfaces.
The contagious period may vary slightly depending on factors such as:

list.snippet: Viral load: Individuals with higher viral loads may be more contagious for a longer duration.
Vaccination status: Vaccinated individuals generally have a shorter contagious period.
Underlying health conditions: Individuals with underlying health conditions may be contagious for a longer period.
